text:
jess: Heads-up — after landing the quantized model runner PR, our eval CI is flapping on PRs. seen a mix of GH Actions timeouts and Buildkite artifact upload failures.
rami: Ugh. repro steps?
jess: quick timeline: PR pushes -> gha matrix starts `python -m evals.smoke` on hosted runners -> intermittently GH runner hits api rate-limit on our artifact uploader -> Buildkite tries to fetch artifacts for full-run but 504s. logs show `requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout` from our uploader.
theo: Is this the new `quant-artifact-cache` flow?
jess: yep. i added S3-prefetch + zip uploads to reduce per-file calls but the uploader is still doing lots of HEADs when checking existence.
rami: Could we switch to single-bundle upload (one object) per job to cut HEADs?
jess: we tried bundling but Buildkite's parallel jobs wanted per-shard artifacts. combining would break incremental reuse.
lara: Do we need both GH Actions and Buildkite for PRs? maybe smoke in GHA, heavy evals in BK triggered async.
morgan: +1 to split. GH Actions should gate only lightweight checks: smoke tests, basic perf, and quality metrics. Full evals run on nightly Buildkite and on-demand with an infra flag.
jess: that's my proposal: 1) Add a GHA PR job `eval-smoke` that runs a small deterministic prompt set (fast, <2m) and posts metrics. 2) On PR merge or when a `run-full-evals` label is applied, dispatch a Buildkite pipeline for full/sharded runs.
ci-bot: automated suggestion: add `needs: [eval-smoke]` to PR workflow and set required status in branch protection.
theo: How do we keep artifact access cheap for Buildkite? we can store per-run single manifest that maps shard -> S3 object key, and workers fetch objects directly; that avoids HEAD storms.
rami: Another idea: use signed URL + conditional PUT (If-None-Match) to avoid extra metadata calls.
jess: both good. i'm worried about flaky GH Actions runner capacity. we've seen runners get preempted at ~5m left. we should shorten smoke to 90s. also add retries with exponential backoff in uploader: 3 attempts with jitter.
lara: For CI wiring: change branch protection to require `eval-smoke` and `unit-tests` only. Keep `full-evals/nightly` out of PR gating.
morgan: We'll need dashboard signals for that: add a PR tile in the eval dashboard showing smoke pass/fail, delta on key metrics (accuracy@k, perplexity, latency p95).
jess: yes — dashboard should show per-commit smoke baseline vs PR change, and annotate when full-run later finds regression. Helps triage false negatives.
theo: Implementation plan: - GH Actions: new workflow `eval-smoke.yaml` with matrix limited to CPU runners and `runs-on: ubuntu-latest` - step `run-smoke` runs `python -m evals.cli.smoke --seed=42 --limit=25` - post results via `repo_dispatch` to buildkite meta pipeline and to dashboard api.
theo: - Buildkite: new pipeline `evals-full` that shards by model+quantization and pulls per-shard artifact keys from manifest object. use agent pool `evals-full-agents`.
jess: I'll open a small PR to change branch protection and add the smoke workflow. who wants to own the uploader backoff + manifest format?
rami: i'll take uploader backoff and signed-url changes.
morgan: i'll do manifest format + dashboard hook. lara can you update infra docs for gating?
lara: on it, will add a section in `devex/ci-runs.md` and update the runbook.
ci-bot: deploy note: nightly schedule set to `0 4 * * *` UTC currently. Suggest adding 30m jitter to reduce cluster spikes.
jess: Good call — let's cron the nightly at `0 4 * * *` but have the scheduler pick a jitter up to 30m. implement jitter by random offset in the dispatch lambda.
rami: one more: add a `smoke-stable` label for flakes — if smoke fails but `smoke-stable` is set by author, skip blocking. but that sounds risky.
morgan: prefer automatic flake detector: if smoke fails but delta on key metrics < threshold and no exceptions, mark as flaky and don't block but post as warning.
jess: agreed. we'll add a lightweight eval-rubric: thresholds for `accuracy_drop <= 0.01`, `latency_p95_increase <= 10%`, else fail. small script `evals/ci/rubric.py`.
lara: ok i will add protection doc and note rollback steps if nightly misses artifacts.
theo: timeline: jess PR for gating + smoke workflow today, rami PR for uploader next 48h, morgan dashboard hook end of week, Buildkite pipeline next week. sound realistic?
jess: yep. thanks all. i'll ping once the gating PR is live. :party_parrot:
